testResults.name: workflow-syntax-and-expressions
testResults.result: actionlint 1.7.12, with ShellCheck 0.11.0 available, and action-validator 0.6.0 reported no errors

testResults.name: ghcr-authentication-and-least-privilege
testResults.result: The publish job grants only contents: read and packages: write, logs in only to ghcr.io as github.actor, and uses the automatically generated secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN; the image-build branch trigger has no Azure permission or deployment step

testResults.name: single-immutable-image-contract
testResults.result: One build-push step publishes ghcr.io/<lowercase-owner>/<lowercase-repository>:<full GITHUB_SHA>, and workflow outputs expose that tag, the registry digest, and the digest-addressed image reference for caller jobs; the image-build push trigger is image-only and does not deploy Azure

testResults.name: pinned-action-revisions
testResults.command: git ls-remote against each action repository and referenced release tag
testResults.result: All four action references are full 40-character commit SHAs matching checkout v4.2.2, setup-buildx v3.12.0, login v3.6.0, and build-push v6.19.0

testResults.name: shared-api-and-ingest-entrypoints
testResults.command: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_package_entrypoints.py
testResults.result: 7 tests passed; the single Dockerfile package entrypoint dispatches both lake api and lake ingest commands

limitations: Docker is unavailable locally, so no local image build or runtime command execution was performed

GHCR authentication, package creation, SHA-tag publication, and emitted registry digest values require a GitHub-hosted run; the image-build push trigger is intentionally image-only and does not invoke Azure deployment
The future caller owned by T031 must grant packages: write because reusable workflows cannot elevate the caller GITHUB_TOKEN permissions
